newsitem.title: USA: Chevron finishes sale of Tengiz field share.
newsitem.headline: Chevron finishes sale of Tengiz field share.

text.p: Chevron Corp said on Thursday it completed the sale of 10 percent of its interest in the Tengizchevroil joint venture to LUKARCO, a joint venture between LUKoil and Atlantic Richfield Co.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
"The addition of LUKARCO to the joint venture offers the consortium valuable expertise and experience in the region," said Dick Matzke, president of Chevron Overseas Petroleum Inc.
The Tengizchevroil joint venture includes Chevron, which now holds a 45 percent stake, the Republic of Kazakstan and Mobil at 25 percent each, and LUKARCO with a five percent stake.

Recoverable reserves at the Tengiz oil field are estimated at six billion barrels of oil, and companies in the joint venture hope to raise the field's production to 700,000 barrels per day (bpd) from the current 160,000 bpd in 15 years.
